title: Theory that shooter Valente was awaiting programmed instruction

tellings.quote: Or maybe he was awaiting instruction, subliminal or conscious instruction.

plain: A shooter Michels calls Valente, connected to events in 2025 in Boston, Providence and Brooklyn, may have been waiting for an instruction, either subliminal or conscious, before he acted. Michels raises this himself as a possibility on an episode about top American scientists going missing, without naming a source. If true, it would suggest someone else was directing him.
